items.title: 16.8 Capacitor ki charging aur discharging (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of charging and discharging a capacitor (PDF 76-78).

blocks.text: Bohat se circuits mein capacitors aur resistors dono hote hain. Fig 16.11 resistor-capacitor (R-C) circuit dikhati hai. Jab switch S terminal A par ho to R-C majmua Vo voltage ki battery se jur jata hai, jo resistor R ke zariye capacitor ko charge karti hai. Capacitor foran charge nahi hota; charge ahista ahista apni tawazun ki qeemat qo = CVo tak barhta hai. Fig 16.12 waqt ke saath charge ka barhna dikhati hai: t = 0 par q = 0 aur ahista ahista qo tak. Kisi lamhe capacitor par voltage V = q/C hai.

blocks.alt: Circuit jis ke oopar wale taar mein resistor R aur capacitor C (plates +q aur -q). Daen taraf switch S terminal A par hai, jo neeche wali battery Vo ko loop mein lata hai; terminal B aik taar par hai jo baen taraf wapas jata hai. Teeron ka loop charging current ko ghari ki sui ki simt (clockwise) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.11: Switch S ko A par rakhe R-C circuit (kitab ki Figure 16.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Charge hote capacitor ke charge q aur waqt t ka graph. Do curves sifar se dashed satah CVo = qo ki taraf uthte hain, aik tezi se (chhota RC) aur aik ahista (bara RC). Dashed satah 0.63qo har curve se milti hai; wahan se dashed lakeerein waqt ke mehwar tak jati hain jahan har curve ka RC likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.12: Chhote aur bare time constant RC ke liye waqt ke saath charge ka barhna (kitab ki Figure 16.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Time constant
blocks.text: Capacitor kitni tezi se charge ya discharge hota hai yeh hasil-e-zarb RC par munhasir hai, jis ki ikai waqt hai aur jise time constant kehte hain. Charging ke liye yeh woh waqt hai jis mein capacitor apne tawazun charge qo ka 0.63 hissa hasil kare. Time constant jitna chhota, charge utni jaldi aakhri qeemat tak pohanchta hai.

Fig 16.13 (a) discharging dikhati hai. Switch B par ho to aik plate ka charge +q resistance se ghoom kar doosri plate ka charge -q khatam karta hai. Fig 16.13 (b) ke graphs dikhate hain ke discharging t = 0 par q = CVo se shuru hoti aur charge ahista ahista sifar tak girta hai; chhota time constant tez discharge deta hai.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Wahi R-C circuit, switch S B par, yani battery bahar; teeron ka loop current ko +q plate se R ke zariye -q plate tak ghari ki sui ke ulat (anticlockwise) dikhata hai. (b) q aur t ka graph: do curves CVo se shuru ho kar sifar ki taraf girte hain, chhote RC ke liye tez aur bare RC ke liye ahista.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.13: (a) S ko B par rakh kar resistor ke zariye capacitor ka discharge; (b) chhote aur bare RC ke liye charge aur waqt (kitab ki Figure 16.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Series RC circuit ka time constant tau = RC hai. Dikhayein ke ohm guna farad aik second hai. Hal: Ohm ke qanoon se V = IR, aur I = q/t se V = (q/t) R, is liye R = Vt/q. Neez C = q/V. Zarb dene se RC = (Vt/q)(q/V) = t. Yun 1 ohm x 1 farad = 1 second.

blocks.prompt: 1 kilo-ohm resistor aur 100 uF capacitor series mein hain. Time constant kya hai?

items: R ke zariye charging: q ahista ahista qo = CVo tak.
Time constant RC (ohm x farad = second); RC ke baad 0.63 qo.
Discharging: q, CVo se girta; chhota RC tez tabdeeli.
